info.name: Battle Service
info.description:
Every route of the Battle Service, called through the API Gateway at {{gatewayUrl}}/battle/api/v1/..., in run order: a challenge is issued, accepted, fought turn by turn and resolved. The Gateway validates the access token, removes Authorization and forwards the trusted identity; Battle sees only that.

The Setup folder prepares real data through the Gateway, so the same run passes whether Battle's dependencies are live or mocked: a package with published stat definitions, players registered with it, their primary creatures in Tamagotchi and a secondary lent to the challenger through Tamagotchi's service route. No credential is stored in the collection.

Set gatewayUrl and serviceToken in the environment, and battleDependencyMode to Battle's DEPENDENCY_MODE (live by default in the team stack; with mock, the unrelated-users refusal cannot be produced and is checked accordingly).
